title: Sprinkler Installation
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

questions.q: Heads evenly spaced, at the right level, clear of obstructions?
Pipework level and square, fittings clean, hangers at max 4 m centres (closer for small bore)?
questions.source: BS EN 12845 / LPC typical hanger spacing; Argus ITP

questions.q: Are heads protected and free from paint or damage?
Ask the fitter: What's the head drop to the ceiling, and where's the nearest support to the penetration? Could they answer?
questions.source: SuperPrime site practice – a fitter who can't answer is a red flag

questions.q: Air test 0.5 bar for 15 min done before the hydraulic test?
Pipework hydraulic tested (15 bar) before boxing in?
questions.source: Argus ITP – BS EN 12845 test, CP14

questions.q: Was the test authorised by MPX before it started (no unauthorised tests)?
Permit to fill issued before the system was filled/tested?
questions.source: Argus sprinkler ITP AFP-00001 – permit to fill

questions.q: Zone/floor isolation valves labelled, strapped open and tamper switches connected?
questions.source: Argus sprinkler ITP AFP-00001 – isolation valve tamper

questions.q: Flow switch fitted and its operation proved (alarm signal to the fire alarm panel)?
questions.source: Argus sprinkler ITP AFP-00001 – flow switch operation (CP16)

questions.q: Drain and test valves accessible and labelled?
questions.source: Argus sprinkler ITP AFP-00001 – valve sets

questions.q: Head escutcheons/cover plates fitted tight to the ceiling, no paint on heads?

notOk.t: Sprinkler head too low – red showing through the ceiling
Cover caps missing, marked or not level
Pipe support over 400 mm from a fire-stopped penetration
Services or trays covering / obstructing heads
